contract.runtime: C++ cleanup resumption preserves Objective-C exception objects entering C catches; 128 throws and rethrows cover balanced C++ adapters.
storage: nested records and fixed-size record arrays
native strong, weak and Block fields mixed with carriers
generated C++ copy, move, assignment, default initialization and destruction
contract.calls: Ordinary synchronous nonvariadic functions use fresh indirect results and callee-owned record argument snapshots. Matching C-compatible declarations share the ABI between C and C++. Direct carriers retain their caller-owned convention.
contract.initialization: Own completed subobjects before initializer temporaries run. Native exceptions and typed errors destroy only completed prefixes in reverse order. Returned records stay callee-owned through lexical and parameter cleanup; NRVO transfers cleanup ownership exactly once.
contract.identity: ABI 10 nominal carrier encodings; stable helper descriptions include layout and native ownership qualifiers.
boundaries: unions and packed or volatile storage
record values in Objective-C method and Block signatures
public Optional/Result and synchronous throws syntax remain reserved

sanitizers.instrumentation: consumer, native fixture, and provider fixtures; SDK runtime loaded as shipped

inspected: enclosing record with scalar, strong and weak carrier fields
managed array subobjects with present and absent elements
